privacy.ai_training_note: Generative AI (Hai): 'HackerOne will not use Customer Input or AI Output to train or improve any shared or general-purpose artificial intelligence models.' (source: hackerone.com/terms/AI). Hai AI documentation confirms: 'Hai does not train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve GenAI or large language models on customer or researcher data.' LLMs are stateless with zero data retention. Non-generative ML features may use Customer Input for service improvement, but 'AI Usage Data will not include Customer Confidential Information and will not be used in a manner that identifies Customer.' Admins can disable customer-facing Hai capabilities.
privacy.data_region: United States (primary). EU-US DPF and Standard Contractual Clauses protect EU data transfers. No multi-region residency option documented for standard tiers.

security.name: Bug Bounty (self-hosted on own platform)
security.value: HackerOne runs its own public bug bounty program on the HackerOne platform. Disclosures published on their Hacktivity page.

security.name: Penetration Testing

security.name: Access Control
security.value: Trust center lists Access Control, Data Access, Logging, and Password Security as documented controls.

security.name: Business Continuity
security.value: BCP, DRP, and Incident Response Plan documents available on request via trust center.

security.name: AI Governance
security.value: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance Framework Policy and Acceptable Use of AI Policy both available on request via trust center.

security.name: Data Processing Agreement
security.value: Pre-signed DPA incorporating Standard Contractual Clauses publicly available.

security.name: Vulnerability Disclosure Transparency
security.value: Valid vulnerabilities in HackerOne's own systems are publicly disclosed once confirmed and resolved, visible on the Hacktivity page.

products.name: H1 Bounty
products.data_scope: Customer vulnerability reports, scoped assets, researcher communications, payment data. Vulnerability data remains Customer Data. No GenAI training on this data.
products.notes: Supports public and private programs. 2M+ researcher community. Customers can disable Hai AI features.

products.name: H1 Pentest / H1 Agentic Pentest
products.data_scope: Customer application data, scope definitions, pentest findings. Compliance-ready reports for SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP.
products.notes: AWS-specific pentesting available. AI-driven agentic pentest scales attack surface coverage.

products.name: H1 Continuous Testing
products.data_scope: Live application assets, vulnerability findings. Data governed by same SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls.
products.notes: Pentest-grade signal continuously rather than point-in-time.

products.name: H1 AI Red Teaming
products.data_scope: Customer AI systems and models under test. Mapped to OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF.
products.notes: Specialist product for organizations deploying AI systems. Different data scope from platform products.

products.name: H1 Code
products.data_scope: Source code when authorized via SCM integrations. Access governed by JIT principles with full audit logging.
products.notes: Hai accesses source code only when authorized. Fix-ready findings delivered into existing workflows.

products.name: H1 Response (VDP)
products.data_scope: External researcher reports, internal triage data. GDPR-compliant disclosure channel.
products.notes: Often used to meet regulatory disclosure mandates. Free/low-cost entry tier available for public programs.

products.name: Hai (Agentic AI Orchestrator)
products.data_scope: Accesses vulnerability reports, metadata, app behavior, source code (when authorized), documentation, issue tracker data. Stateless LLMs; zero data retention post-request.
products.notes: Admins can disable customer-facing Hai features. HackerOne continues using Hai internally for Triage even when disabled.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise / sales-led. No public pricing. Bug bounty programs pay per confirmed result (pay-for-results model). Pentest and continuous testing on subscription/contract basis.
compare.data_residency: United States (primary). EU-US DPF + SCCs for EU customers. No self-managed data residency options documented.

flags: FedRAMP authorization is Tailored LI-SaaS (Low Impact), not Moderate or High. Government agencies requiring higher impact levels should verify separately.
Non-generative ML features may use Customer Input for service improvement (not GenAI). Admins should review AI terms at hackerone.com/terms/AI if sensitive.
Hai AI continues operating internally for Triage even when admins disable customer-facing Hai features. Customers should be aware of this distinction.
HackerOne itself is a security vendor, so it operates its own bug bounty program on its own platform, providing exceptional transparency into its own vulnerability posture.
